name: sitesmith-gates
description: What the SiteSmith gates need in order to run. Installed by `sitesmith install`. verify.mjs loads 'playwright' and '@axe-core/playwright' by exactly those specifiers, so those are what is pinned. axe-core is pinned as well because it is the engine the wrapper drives, and an unpinned engine changes what counts as a violation from one machine to the next.
